simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חֲקוּפָא (H2709) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: חֲקוּפָא (Chăqûwphâʼ) means Chakupha , one of the Nethinim First listed occurrence: Ezra 2 51.

definitions.full: H2709. Chaqupha חֲקוּפָא proper name, masculine head of a family of returning exiles Ezra 2:51 = Neh 7:53 , ᵐ5 Αφεικα , Αχειφα , Ακουφα , etc.
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root probably meaning to bend; crooked;
